SELECT sp.id AS "id", sp.id AS "personId", sp.identity_card AS "identityCard", sp.name AS "personName", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.id ORDER BY a.update_date DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS "bindIds", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.area_id ORDER BY sa.area_name SEPARATOR ',') AS "areaId", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.area_id ORDER BY sa.area_name SEPARATOR ',') AS "areaIds", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sa.area_name ORDER BY sa.area_name SEPARATOR ',') AS "areaName", MAX(a.remarks) AS "remarks", sp.status AS "status", sp.create_by AS "createBy", sp.create_date AS "createDate", sp.update_by AS "updateBy", sp.update_date AS "updateDate", COALESCE(jso.office_name, sp.company) AS "company", COALESCE(pa.position_name, sp.department) AS "department", COALESCE(pl.prod_line_name, sp.prod_line) AS "prodLine", COALESCE(wg.work_group_name, sp.team) AS "team", sp.job_type AS "jobType" FROM swm_person sp LEFT JOIN ( swm_person_work_area a INNER JOIN swm_area sa ON a.area_id = sa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND sa.status = '0' ) ON sp.identity_card = a.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND a.status = '0' LEFT JOIN js_sys_office jso ON sp.company = jso.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive pa ON sp.department = pa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line pl ON sp.prod_line = pl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON sp.team = wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
sp.status = '0' AND sp.personnel_status = '1'
AND sp.identity_card LIKE CONCAT('%', #{identityCard}, '%')
AND sp.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
AND ( jso.office_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{company}, '%') OR sp.company = #{company} OR sp.company LIKE CONCAT('%', #{company}, '%') )
AND ( pa.position_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%') OR sp.department = #{department} OR sp.department LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%') )
AND ( pl.prod_line_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{prodLine}, '%') OR sp.prod_line = #{prodLine} OR sp.prod_line LIKE CONCAT('%', #{prodLine}, '%') )
AND ( wg.work_group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{team}, '%') OR sp.team = #{team} OR sp.team LIKE CONCAT('%', #{team}, '%') )
AND sp.job_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{jobType}, '%')
AND sa.id = #{areaId}
AND sa.area_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{areaName}, '%')
GROUP BY sp.id, sp.identity_card, sp.name, sp.status, sp.create_by, sp.create_date, sp.update_by, sp.update_date, jso.office_name, sp.company, pa.position_name, sp.department, pl.prod_line_name, sp.prod_line, wg.work_group_name, sp.team, sp.job_type ORDER BY sp.update_date DESC, MAX(a.update_date) DESC
